 Summary

 Implement Issue #25 with deterministic repository-hosted SVG throughput charts for JSON, PostgreSQL, and CPU, generated from the same validated official report as the README tables.

 The publication transaction will update result JSON, history, both READMEs, and the allowlisted chart assets atomically. The official benchmark methodology and active cohort remain unchanged.

 TDD

 The first commit is intentionally RED: it requires a new benchmark.readme_charts generator and README chart references before production code exists.

 Closes #25
